In the private study of an opulent Victorian manor. The room is luxuriously decorated, with family portraits adorning the walls and ancient tomes meticulously arranged on the bookshelves. Duke Fernandez is seated, while twelve-year-old James stands in the center, awaiting Isabella's arrival with a palpable sense of anxiety.

The Duke sits behind an imposing desk, donned in a dark, formal suit, exuding authority and severity. He looks down at James, a complex mix of emotions flickering in his gaze. James, dressed tidily, appears tense and uneasy.

"James," the Duke intones deeply, "today I am introducing someone vital to you. From now on, she will oversee your daily life, for you will no longer stay with me but live independently within this estate."

At that moment, the door gently swings open. Isabella enters, clad in a black head maid's uniform, her hair neatly secured behind her head. Her steps are measured, her gaze calm and piercing.

"Isabella, this is my son James," the Duke announces. "From this day forth, you will be responsible for all his affairs."

Isabella offers a slight bow, her tone respectful yet icy: "Yes, Your Grace, I will attend to the young master with utmost diligence."

She turns, casting her gaze upon James, a professional smile gracing her lips, though a flicker of disdain lurks in her eyes. "Master James, I am Isabella. I will be in charge of your every need henceforth. Should you require anything, please do not hesitate to inform me."

James feels a shiver run up his spine, instinctively taking a step backward. He is acutely unsettled and fearful of Isabella's calm and piercing eyes. Mustering a strained smile, his voice quivering, he replies, "Thank you, Isabella."

The Duke nods in satisfaction, turning to leave the room. As the door closes, the atmosphere becomes palpably heavier, laden with an oppressive silence.

As the door clicked shut, Isabella swiftly moved in front of James, towering over his diminutive frame. Her cold eyes bore into his, thinly veiling a contemptuous disdain. "Master James," she intoned, "from now on, I shall be your dedicated head maid. Your father has entrusted your care and education to me."

She leaned in, her face mere inches from his, her hot breath engulfing James, causing his cheeks to flush and his heart to race. Isabella's voice remained devoid of emotion as she continued, "I will diligently attend to you, young master, but your father also instructed me to address any misdoings..."

Suddenly, with her right hand, she began to roughly squeeze James's genitals through his clothes. Despite James's attempts to struggle, Isabella's left hand held him firmly in place. She pushed her face so close it was almost within kissing distance, her breath and words searing into his mind, "For any mistakes, punishment will follow, master..."

With a final, merciless squeeze, Isabella then abruptly released him and opened the door, gesturing for the gasping James to follow. "Master James, do not dawdle. The Duke has departed, and I shall now acquaint you with the estate and its servants."
